leadText: Mariko Kouda (Japanese: 國府田マリ子 Kouda Mariko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Mariko Kouda (Japanese: 國府田マリ子 Kouda Mariko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kouda was born on September 5, 1989, in , . She graduated from Kasukabe Kyōei High School and became a communications major at Tamagawa University in . After graduating from college in 1990, Kouda became a voice actress, singer, and radio personality as an adult. She was once affiliated with the voice acting group Drops, which has since disbanded. Kouda became involved with the during , voicing recurring character Sakura, a Kimono Girl. She is currently affiliated with the talent management firm . She announced her marriage in 2003.
